figures.notes: The low-band held-out ACFs have visibly larger and less stationary excursions than the training mean, especially near zero lag and across the broad negative trough. The high-band train and held-out curves are comparatively compact. The plotted behavior supports a frequency-dependent qualification result rather than a single transferable kernel.

Only three of six low-band held-out slices satisfy both fixed thresholds; the first three exceed the reduced predictive chi-square ceiling and the first marginally exceeds max abs(z)=3. All six high-band slices satisfy both thresholds. The bars and threshold guides agree with validation.json.

The low-band near-resolution width injections are not identifiable against the measured background: recovered widths span both fit limits, including a 400 kHz upper-bound solution for a 12.2 kHz injection. The remaining width scatter, 25 percent nominal-68 coverage, and modulation-index deviations fail the predeclared recovery gates.

science_disposition: A1 DOCUMENTED-FAIL; the additive off-pulse likelihood is not qualified for Freya, the on-pulse fit remains forbidden, and CHIME remains diagnostic_only without fleet propagation
